value.name: hesitates to call Marcus
value.description: She stops herself from dialing Marcus, unable to force him through the situation by voice.
evidence: she could not put Marcus through that door in a voice
She tapped back out without dialing

value.name: messages social worker about pickup
value.description: She opens the social worker's thread and sends a message saying she will not pick Marcus up and that the county step-down bed should be confirmed.
evidence: opened the social worker's thread, and typed that she would not be picking him up, that the county step-down bed should be confirmed

value.name: offers to release consent
value.description: She says she will call the unit herself to release any consent needed from her side.
evidence: that she would call the unit herself to release whatever consent they needed from her end

value.name: sets phone down after sending
value.description: After the message sends, she places the phone face down on the counter and rests her palm against it.
evidence: She set the phone face down on the counter after it sent and stood with her palm flat against the back of it

value.name: realizes brother is on same path
value.description: She understands that she has sent Marcus onto the same institutional track she recently pulled her father off of.
evidence: she understood, without rearranging the thought to make it easier, that she had just routed her brother onto the same track she had spent a week pulling her father off of

value.name: recognizes apartment unchanged
value.description: She registers that the apartment behind her is still the same room she entered an hour earlier and will not be different by noon.
evidence: the apartment behind her was still the room she had walked into an hour ago and would not be anything else by noon
